test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 21 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the sixth letter-cluster in the same way as the first letter-cluster is related to the second letter-cluster and the third letter-cluster is related to the fourth letter-cluster.

OUTPUT : TUOTUP :: MUMBAI : MUMIAB :: ? : CUBTEK
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, ‘OUTPUT is written as TUOTUP’,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7ca1bf2daaf001215260293cfc59278174ea8a8958e5a1d70dfd688715fac1b1.png] 

For, 'MUMBAI is written as MUMIAB'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c91e1b934fa08542b2afdba265c8bcce01b54c7433b510214790b6eb28b62e5f.png] 

Similarly, 'BUCKET' will be written as 'CUMTEK'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8f37d17496abb9e7c71e089e6c1d13eec896e3c5c602e54a693653a22d1ad1cd.png] 

So, 'BUCKET' will be written as 'CUMTEK'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4"
